scientific_budget_source: Complete original parameter file and direct finite-phase scientific program.
scientific_protocol: Use the complete R752 material metric at phase zero on each initial physical chart, including both delayed-turn collars and the two entire planar cap domains. At every positive time knot optimize nineteen explicit intrinsic geometry/rigid-cap coordinates with both independent three-component roll fields. Reuse fixed field coefficients and exact hierarchical material basis names at the next degree. The grip and cap/central metric are implemented by the R753 geometry. Absorb full upper and lower physical boundary displacements in each roll. Compare direct R753 six-jets on all actual charts at the last phase, record all four seam residuals at each phase, and report independent finer spatial and temporal Gram, curvature, immersion, support, whole-image chord and moment samples. Pure coefficient values, singular geometry or a finite numerical sample provide no rigorous whole-domain certificate.
canonical_point_words: Each scientific stage emits the SHA-256 of its complete C-order little-endian float64 time-knot by physical-coefficient matrix, each actual solved positive-time row, its independent phase-knot digest and the complete NPZ identity. The first nineteen coordinates give the rectifying-cylinder control, two three-parameter fan displacements and independent six-parameter upper and lower cap poses. Two further equal-sized blocks contain every complete three-component annular control.
